Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the Team + Role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Proactive Capabilities team builds novel tooling and leverages state-of-the-art automation to eliminate business impact from threat actors! Our mission is to close critical attack paths before they can be exploited and to mitigate active threats with speed and precision.

As a Software Engineer on the Proactive Capabilities team , you will design, build, and scale engineering tools that empower Security Engineers, eliminate operational toil, and expand security coverage across Robinhood. This is a creative, high-impact role where you will identify high-priority security challenges, evaluate buy-vs-build opportunities, and turn one-off solutions into robust, company-wide security capabilities!

This role is based in our Bellevue, WA and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What You'll Do

• Build and scale flexible, reliable security tooling and services that improve visibility and expand scan coverage across Robinhood and its entities.

• Design and deploy AI agents and security automation workflows to drive and prevent proactive security risk discovery and remediation.

• Partner cross-functionally with Security Engineering and Product Engineering teams to establish secure-by-default software design patterns and paved paths

• Participate in design and system reviews alongside Proactive Security initiatives.

• Participate in an on-call rotation to maintain high availability and reliability for critical team security services.

What You'll Need

• Proven software engineering fundamentals and practical system design skills, with experience building scalable, reliable microservices and tools.

• Proficiency in Go or Python (with a preference for Go).

• Hands-on experience building and deploying services in cloud environments (AWS preferred, or GCP equivalent).

• Solid foundational knowledge of containerization and Kubernetes concepts.

• Strong security domain context, including an understanding of the attacker lifecycle, application security concepts, and hands-on experience developing or integrating security tooling.

• A pragmatic, curious, and collaborative mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguous problem spaces and independently identify high-value engineering solutions.

Bonus Points

• Experience applying AI, LLMs, or agentic frameworks to solve complex security problems.

• Background in developer productivity, security automation, or toil-reduction initiatives.

• Deep Application Security (AppSec) experience, bug bounty participation, or CTF competition experience.

• Advanced Kubernetes experience or a track record of building enterprise security platforms at scale.

What We Offer

• Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.

title: Sr. Product Designer II - Design Systems
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart , we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview
Instacart ’s Design Systems & Foundations team builds the shared components, tokens, and guidance that power customer, shopper, retailer, and internal tools at scale. We’re looking for a design-first, technically fluent product designer to lead the evolution of our design system as a product-raising quality, usability, scalability, and adoption across multiple product surfaces.
In this role, you’ll partner closely with engineering and design technologists to ensure design-to-code fidelity, integrate guidance directly inside design and development workflows, and shape a durable “source of truth” that can power automation, guardrails, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate with an 8-person foundations team and cross-functional partners to unlock velocity and consistency for product teams serving millions of customers.
About the Job

• Own and drive the design system roadmap-prioritizing by product needs, system health, and adoption friction-while aligning stakeholders on a clear, forward-looking vision.

• Define and evolve system UX: components, patterns, interaction states, responsive behavior, motion, and accessibility defaults that scale across products and platforms.

• Lead token strategy end to end (primitive and semantic), including theming, density, and extensibility, and partner with engineering to maintain consistent component APIs.

• Establish strong governance and lifecycle management: contribution standards, quality bars, review processes, versioning, deprecations, and clear migration plans to reduce system drift.

• Create implementation-aware specs with edge cases, constraints, usage guidance, and acceptance criteria; collaborate in component-based workflows (e.g., Figma libraries, Storybook) to ensure design-to-code fidelity.

• Build design enablement in context-linting rules, templates, and plugin experiences-supported by a structured knowledge model (rules, constraints, examples) that powers automation and AI-assisted support.

• Use AI tools intentionally to streamline audits, consistency checks, migrations, and spec generation; contribute to AI-assisted workflows that help teams adopt changes safely.

• Measure adoption and impact, identify workflow friction, and execute enablement programs that reduce rework, raise consistency, and accelerate safe system evolution.

About You
Minimum Qualifications

• 6+ years of experience in product design (or equivalent), including shipping and maintaining a design system adopted by multiple product teams.

• Portfolio showcasing design systems mastery (components, patterns, tokens, governance) and cross-platform consistency; portfolio link required.

• Technical fluency collaborating in component-based workflows (e.g., Figma component libraries and Storybook or equivalent) with a strong understanding of how implementation constraints shape UX.

title: Młodszy Prawnik + biegły w pracy z AI (pół etatu/pełny etat)
description:
Telemedi to jedna z najszybciej rosnących firm telemedycznych w Europie Środkowo-Wschodniej. Budujemy platformę B2B, z której korzystają ubezpieczyciele, banki i pracodawcy. Działamy na styku trzech bardzo regulowanych światów: ochrony zdrowia, ubezpieczeń i technologii - a to znaczy, że prawo jest u nas nie kosztem, tylko częścią produktu.
Szukamy osoby na początku drogi zawodowej, która chce nauczyć się rzemiosła prawniczego w wymagającym środowisku i traktuje AI jako naturalne narzędzie pracy - tak jak nasz zespół IT programuje z AI, tak dążymy by wszystkie pozostałe działy potrafiły z nim współpracować.
Requirements
Czego szukamy
To nie jest ogłoszenie o „przeklikiwanie umów". Szukamy określonego sposobu myślenia i postępowania (umiejętności technicznych i dopasowania do zasad, które cenimy w organizacji).
Krytyczne myślenie i łączenie kropek. Potrafisz wziąć przepis, kontrakt, decyzję organu i pismo drugiej strony - i zobaczyć, jak to się ze sobą łączy. Nie zatrzymujesz się na tym, „co jest napisane", tylko pytasz „co z tego wynika" i „jaka jest za tym logika; gdzie jest ryzyko, którego nikt nie nazwał". Wątpliwość traktujesz jako sygnał do drążenia, nie jako problem do pominięcia.
Sprawność proceduralna. Rozumiesz, że prawo to nie tylko treść, ale i tryb: terminy, właściwość organu, forma, kolejność kroków, droga odwoławcza.
AI jako narzędzie myślenia, nie wyręczania się. Używasz LLM-ów do tego, w czym są dobre: szybkiego przeczesania dużej ilości materiału, analizy danych, sprawdzania własnego rozumowania „pod światło". Ale wiesz, gdzie AI się myli, weryfikujesz każde źródło i bierzesz pełną odpowiedzialność za wynik. AI ma czynić Cię szybszym i bardziej wnikliwym - nie zastępować Twojego osądu.
Analiza danych. Nie boisz się arkusza, zestawienia, rejestru. Potrafisz z danych - wykazu postępowań, historii decyzji, parametrów umów - wyciągnąć wzorzec i przełożyć go na argument prawny lub rekomendację.
Zakres obowiązków
Wejdziesz w szerokie spektrum spraw obejmujących codzienne funkcjonowanie firmy:

• Analiza i przygotowywanie umów oraz dokumentów kontraktowych (B2B, dostawcy, partnerzy)

• Research prawny i przygotowywanie analiz oraz notatek na potrzeby biznesu

• Wsparcie w obszarze compliance i ochrony danych osobowych

• Udział w prowadzeniu postępowań oraz przygotowanie pism i korespondencji z organami

• Monitorowanie zmian w przepisach istotnych dla działalności firmy

• Budowanie i doskonalenie wewnętrznych narzędzi i workflowów wspieranych AI dla obsługi prawnej

Czego oczekujemy

• Wykształcenie prawnicze (ukończone studia lub ostatnie lata)

• Bardzo dobra umiejętność analizy tekstu i logicznego, ustrukturyzowanego myślenia

• Skrupulatność i odpowiedzialność za szczegół

• Naturalna ciekawość wobec AI i chęć włączenia jej do codziennej pracy

• Bardzo dobra polszczyzna w mowie i piśmie, dobra znajomość angielskiego

• Proaktywność i samodzielność w szukaniu odpowiedzi

Mile widziane

• Pierwsze doświadczenie (praktyki, staż) w kancelarii lub dziale prawnym

• Zainteresowanie prawem medycznym, farmaceutycznym, ochroną danych lub regulacjami sektora ubezpieczeń

• Doświadczenie w pracy z narzędziami AI wykraczające poza podstawowe użycie

Co oferujemy

•
Wynagrodzenie: 7 000-14 000 PLN (B2B lub umowa zlecenie)

• Praca z Warszawy lub w pełni zdalnie

• Realny wpływ na to, jak obsługa prawna firmy korzysta z AI

• Środowisko, w którym prawo dotyka prawdziwego produktu i realnych decyzji biznesowych

• Szerokie spektrum spraw - nie zaszufladkujesz się w jednej wąskiej dziedzinie

Benefits

Nasze wartości

• Organizational "YES": Witamy osoby, które z entuzjazmem podchodzą do zmian i nowych możliwości.

• 5x why, first principles: Zachęcamy do zadawania pytań "dlaczego?" i szukania lepszych rozwiązań.

• Data-driven: Wspieramy decyzje rzetelnymi danymi i analizami. Zawsze weryfikujemy informacje u źródła -nie przyjmujemy założeń bez sprawdzenia faktów i danych.

The hardware design team writes the RTL for SambaNova's RDU, the processor behind our AI workload acceleration systems, covering the compute, memory, and networking subsystems. Engineers own specific blocks inside a larger subsystem, working alongside the principal engineers and architects who set its direction. A block stays with the engineer who wrote it through PPA closure, tapeout, and bring-up, so you debug your own design in silicon.

About the role

SambaNova Senior Hardware Design Engineers design component units of the Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit (RDU) ASICs deployed in our AI workload acceleration systems. You will work alongside principal engineers, architects, design verification engineers, and physical design engineers to implement innovative features in hardware that provide unique value to SambaNova.

In this role you will take ownership of blocks within a larger subsystem - contributing sections of the microarchitecture specification, writing and debugging the RTL, and carrying your blocks through implementation, tapeout, and silicon bring-up. You will grow your scope over time as you build depth in our architecture.

This role is onsite, based in either our San Jose, CA or Austin, TX office.

Responsibilities

Some of your responsibilities will include...

• Work with principal engineers and architects to author sections of the microarchitecture specification for compute, memory, or networking subsystems.

• Code, integrate, and debug SystemVerilog RTL for assigned blocks through the chip implementation and production lifecycle.

• Meet Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) targets for your blocks using advanced digital design techniques for high-speed design.

• Partner with design verification and physical design engineers to converge on functionality, timing, and area.

• Implement SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and run lint, CDC, and LEC flows to check design intent and keep blocks clean.

• Participate in design reviews, presenting your design decisions and incorporating feedback.

• Support post-silicon bring-up and debug for the blocks you own.

• Contribute to design flow improvements, including AI and automation in EDA tool methodologies.

Required qualifications

• Master's degree in Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering with 3-5 years of relevant experience, or Bachelor's degree with 5-7 years.

• Solid foundation in computer architecture and digital logic design.

• Strong SystemVerilog RTL design skills for high-speed, high-performance ASICs.

title: Software Engineer, Data, AI & UX
description:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified - giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship .

About the Role

As a member of the Data team, you will build the services, infrastructure, and data platforms that power our business. Our team is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and distributing large volumes of data reliably and efficiently, enabling teams across the business to make data-driven decisions and build innovative products. 

This role sits at the intersection of backend software engineering and data engineering. You will develop scalable backend services, design and maintain data pipelines, and build the underlying data infrastructure that enables reliable, cost-effective, and high-performance data processing. 

You'll work closely with other engineering teams, data consumers, and infrastructure specialists to build robust solutions that balance technical excellence with delivering business value. While the role involves technical collaboration across the organization, it is primarily focused on engineering rather than stakeholder management. 

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, takes ownership of their work, and can make pragmatic engineering decisions that maximize impact. 

This will be a full-time role, owning the following responsibilities :

• Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend services and APIs in Python that support data ingestion, processing, and distribution.

• Building and maintaining reliable data ingestion pipelines for structured and unstructured data from a wide variety of internal and external sources.

• Developing reusable frameworks and tooling that simplify onboarding new data sources and improve developer productivity.

• Designing and optimizing scalable data platforms, including databases, data lakes, metadata catalogues, and storage solutions.

• Continuously improving the reliability, scalability, observability, and cost-efficiency of our data infrastructure.

• Integrating data across multiple systems while reducing duplication and ensuring high data quality.

• Developing and maintaining orchestration workflows and automated data processing pipelines.

• Building internal libraries and services that enable other engineering teams to access and consume data efficiently.

• Monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing production systems and data pipelines.

• Contributing to architecture discussions and technical decisions across the data platform.

• Collaborating closely with software engineers, data engineers, infrastructure engineers, and data consumers to deliver high-impact solutions.

• Continuously identifying opportunities to simplify systems, improve automation, and reduce operational overhead.

At OpenAI, our Trust, Safety & Risk Operations teams safeguard our products, users, and the company from abuse, fraud, scams, regulatory non-compliance, and other emerging risks. - Partner cross-functionally with Product, Policy, Legal, Investigations, and local market teams to execute safety outcomes and manage risk.

- Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement, improving workflows, tools, automation, and escalation paths.

- Identify emerging risks and trends, translating frontline insights into actionable recommendations for policy, product, or enforcement.

- You have 8+ years of experience in Trust & Safety, Risk Operations, Investigations, Fraud, Annotation, or platform integrity.

- You have 4+ years of direct people leadership or senior-level operational ownership, including coaching experienced operators, setting clear direction and supporting independent judgement.

- You have applied AI tools and automation to improve operational workflows, with sound judgment about where human review remains essential.

- You are deeply familiar with trust and safety operations, across multiple risk areas including content moderation, user safety, fraud, or developer risk frameworks, including the legal, policy, and technical considerations that shape enforcement.

title: Senior Product Manager (Data APIs)
description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets - the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

THE OPPORTUNITY

 

9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com http://9fin.com. But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.

 

These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.

 

The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy. You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors. You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data. The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).

 

You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.

 

This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.

 
 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

PRODUCT STRATEGY & EXECUTION

- Define the product vision and strategy for 9fin's external data distribution: APIs, data shares, and future delivery mechanisms (cloud sync, pub/sub).

- Own the data catalogue decisions: which datasets to expose, in what format, through which channels, and in what order, balancing client demand, data readiness, and commercial potential

- Design the developer experience end-to-end: API design, documentation, developer portal, sandbox/playground, error handling, rate limiting, and versioning

- Work with analytics engineering and domain teams to define schemas, data models, and transformation logic that make 9fin's data consumable and valuable outside the application

- Use a partner model to validate early: select and work closely with 1-2 clients during developme

• Partner with Revenue Operations to improve attribution, lead routing, source tracking, and data quality across ad platforms, HubSpot, and Salesforce.

• Use AI as a default part of the work to accelerate analysis, report

title: Pricing Analyst

You'll own pricing end to end - from fast-turnaround spot quotes on key North American lanes through to contract rate structures and RFP responses. It's a role for someone who can price a load in ten minutes and model a year-long agreement in the same week, always with margin in view.
What You'll Do

• Conduct market benchmarking to validate pricing against spot and contract conditions

• Monitor contract compliance - ensuring invoiced rates match agreed terms - and resolve pricing discrepancies

• Support ad hoc pricing analysis and reporting requests

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics, or related field (or equivalent experience)

• 2-3 years of experience in pricing, revenue management, or analytics - freight/logistics/3PL experience strongly preferred

• Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, modeling); SQL or BI tool experience (Power BI/Tableau) an asset

• Familiarity with TMS platforms (McLeod, Trimble, MercuryGate, etc.) and freight market data sources (DAT, SONAR)

• Strong communication skills to support cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Carrier Sourcing, and Finance

Benefits

• Competitive Pay

• Career Growth

title: Senior Storage Systems Engineer - remote in the US
description:
Overview
The role is to deploy, integrate, and operate high-performance storage for GPU-accelerated compute and AI platforms. You will own the storage layer where Kubernetes meets bare metal - standing up NFS-based high-performance storage, wiring it into clusters via CSI, and tuning it to keep data flowing to GPU workloads at scale. Work spans hybrid, edge, and air-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack.
About the Role
We are looking for a senior systems engineer who treats storage as infrastructure to be automated, observed, and tuned - not hand-managed. The right candidate is fluent in Kubernetes storage, deeply versed in Linux storage and networking fundamentals down to the kernel and NFS-client layer, and knows how to make high-performance NAS actually perform under demanding workloads. You should reach for infrastructure-as-code and GitOps by default, be self-directed in diagnosing performance and reliability issues end to end, set operational standards for others to follow, and communicate clearly across teams. Bare-metal hardware experience is a strong plus, but deep Linux storage knowledge is essential.
Responsibilities
1. Storage Integration & Operation

• Integrate NFS-based high-performance storage (e.g., VAST, Dell PowerScale) into Kubernetes clusters via CSI, storage classes, and persistent volumes.

• Tune the NFS data path - mount options, nconnect/RDMA, Linux client, and network settings - for high-throughput, low-latency GPU/AI workloads.

• Deploy and operate storage services and operators; manage capacity, quotas, snapshots, and lifecycle.

2. Linux Platform & System Integration

• Configure and optimize Linux systems for storage workloads, including driver setup, file system layout, network tuning, and kernel parameter optimization.

• Deliver storage integration for k0s-based Kubernetes via Cluster API (CAPI) and K0rdent management/child cluster topologies.

• Operate storage in fully disconnected (air-gapped) environments, including local artifact/mirror connectivity (Harbor) and PKI/TLS considerations.

3. Automation & Observability

• Automate storage provisioning and configuration with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and GitOps pipelines (ArgoCD or Flux).

• Build monitoring, alerting, and observability for storage performance, capacity, and health.

• Diagnose and resolve performance, reliability, and scaling issues across the storage stack.

Required qualifications:

• 7+ years of experience in SRE or hardware/storage infrastructure operations

• 5+ years of building/operating distributed production Storage systems at scale

• 7+ years of experience in Linux and K8s storage fundamentals (NFS, CSI)

• 1+ years of experience integrating with or building High Performance Storage solutions (VAST, Weka, DDN, PowerScale)

What does Mirantis offer you?

- Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
- Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;

title: Marketing Operations Lead
description:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books - all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Marketing Operations Lead to own the data and systems layer underneath Rho's marketing team. Today that layer is split across a dozen platforms, most of it unmodeled, and nobody owns it full time. The result is that we can tell you what we spent and roughly what came in, but not reliably which channels produce funded customers at what cost.

Your job is to close that gap and keep it closed. You'll define what marketing measures, get every source into Snowflake as modeled data, and build the reporting that the marketing team, the exec team, and the board actually run on.

This is a hands-on, single-threaded role. You work in the same data infrastructure as the rest of the company: Snowflake and dbt, alongside our data engineering team. You are explicitly not here to build a parallel marketing data stack inside Salesforce, HubSpot, or a spreadsheet. If it matters, it lives in the warehouse.

You partner with data engineering rather than reporting into it. They own the platform and the pipelines. You own the definitions, the marketing models, the activation layer, and whether the numbers are right.

You're accountable for whether marketing can answer its own questions without waiting on anyone, and for whether spend decisions get made on data that holds up. Not for closed tickets or built dashboards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the marketing metrics layer: define the grain, the metric definitions, and the join path to funnel and funded outcomes for every marketing source. This is the current bottleneck, and it becomes yours on day one.

- Land and model the full source list in Snowflake: paid social, web analytics, search console, organic social across four platforms, affiliate and referral, call platform data, CRM lead and opportunity data, and AI search visibility. Work with data engineering on ingestion; own the dbt models on top.

- Build channel-level attribution that survives scrutiny, including reconciling the known gaps between ad platform reporting, the CRM, and our call platform, where the same funnel currently returns three different numbers.

- Ship and maintain the recurring reporting the business runs on: weekly channel performance and cost per funded customer, CAC and payback by channel and cohort against target, and the marketing health view.

- Own the activation layer: reverse ETL out of the warehouse into lifecycle, ads, and sales tooling, so audiences and triggers are built from modeled data rather than hand-pulled lists.

- Own marketing systems hygiene end to end: form capture, lead routing and CRM sync, UTM and campaign taxonomy, and the data contracts between marketing tools and the warehouse.

- Make PII handling correct by design in the marketing stack, including where lead capture data is allowed to land and what gets passed to third-party platforms.

- Instrument new programs as they launch rather than after, so a channel is measurable the week it goes live.

- Leave every model and pipeline with documentation and monitoring, so a wrong number surfaces on a dashboard before it surfaces in a board meeting.

REQUIREMENTS

- You write SQL fluently and have built and owned dbt models in a real warehouse. This is not a role you can do from platform UIs.

- You've owned marketing or GTM data at a company where the answer mattered financially, and you've been the person who had to defend a CAC or attribution number to a skeptical executive.

- You've reconciled conflicting numbers across ad platforms, a CRM, and a warehouse, and can explain why they differ rather than picking the flattering one.

You will turn complex data landscapes into scalable, trusted data models and help build the semantic foundation for the next generation of BI, self-service analytics, and AI-powered data experiences. If you combine strong engineering fundamentals with excellent data modeling skills and curiosity for semantic layers and AI, this is your opportunity to make a significant impact.

- Enterprise Integration: You have experience integrating data from multiple heterogeneous systems and are comfortable dealing with conflicting identifiers, changing source structures, inconsistent definitions, and complex cross-domain dependencies

- Semantic Thinking: You understand why consistent business definitions, metrics, metadata, and semantic models are essential for scalable BI and increasingly for AI-driven analytics; previous experience with Snowflake Semantic Views, dbt Semantic Layer, MetricFlow or similar technologies is a plus

- AI Mindset: You are curious about how AI is changing data engineering and analytics, actively use or explore AI-assisted engineering tools, and understand that AI output is only as trustworthy as the underlying data models and semantic context

- Engineering Discipline: You have experience with version control, pull requests, automated testing, CI/C

At Capco Poland, we’re not just another consultancy - we’re the spark behind digital transformation in the financial world. As a global leader in technology and management consulting, we thrive on helping clients tackle the toughest challenges across banking, payments, capital markets, wealth, and asset management.

Help financial institutions navigate complex regulatory expectations and turn regulatory requirements into practical, sustainable change.

The Role

As a Senior Manager in our Risk & Regulatory practice at Capco, you will advise financial institutions on complex regulatory, risk and supervisory matters, helping clients understand regulatory expectations and translate them into effective business responses.

You will work closely with senior client stakeholders across Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance and business functions, supporting engagements involving regulatory change, supervisory reviews, remediation programs and interactions with regulatory authorities, including the Polish Financial Supervision Authority (KNF).

This is a senior advisory role combining regulatory knowledge, consulting expertise and strong stakeholder management. You will help clients assess regulatory implications, identify gaps, define practical solutions and deliver sustainable change while contributing to the continued development of Capco’s Risk & Regulatory offering in Poland.

What You’ll Do

• Advise banks and other financial institutions on regulatory and risk matters, translating regulatory requirements and supervisory expectations into practical business actions and transformation initiatives.

• Support clients in preparing for and responding to regulatory engagements, including interactions with KNF, supervisory reviews, inspections, findings and subsequent remediation programs.

• Lead regulatory assessments and remediation engagements, identifying gaps, defining target-state solutions and establishing clear governance and implementation of roadmaps.

• Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance and business functions, providing clear advice on complex regulatory topics and supporting effective decision-making.

• Lead client engagements and contribute to the growth of Capco’s Risk & Regulatory offering through proposition development, client conversations and the identification of new advisory opportunities.

What We’re Looking For

• Significant experience in risk, regulatory or compliance advisory within financial services, gained within consulting, banking, a regulatory environment or a combination of these.

• Strong knowledge of the Polish and European financial services regulatory environment, with experience interpreting regulatory requirements and understanding their practical implications for financial institutions.

• Practical experience supporting regulatory interactions, supervisory reviews, regulatory remediation or related programs, ideally involving KNF.

• Strong advisory and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to communicate complex regulatory matters clearly to senior management and work effectively across business and control functions.

• Experience leading consulting engagements or complex regulatory initiatives, including managing teams, senior stakeholders, delivery priorities and client outcomes.

• Direct experience working with, or supporting engagements involving, KNF or other European financial services regulators.

• Knowledge across multiple areas of banking regulation, risk management, governance, compliance or regulatory remediation.

Bonus Points For

• Experience developing regulatory propositions
